title: Kauravas vs Pandavas: The Battle for Justice ⚔️
description:
he Mahabharata is India’s greatest epic, and at its heart lies the legendary Kurukshetra War — the clash between the Pandavas and the Kauravas.

In this Pale Blue Thoughts video, we explore the battle for justice, dharma, and truth in the Mahabharata. Was this war simply a fight for power, or was it the ultimate struggle between good and evil?

We break down the roles of Arjuna, Krishna, Bhima, Duryodhana, Karna, and the rest of the warriors who shaped the outcome of this epic battle. Discover the lessons of Kurukshetra, the strategy behind the war, and why the Mahabharata continues to inspire and provoke debate even today.

Keywords included: Mahabharata, Kurukshetra war, Pandavas vs Kauravas, Mahabharata explained, Arjuna vs Duryodhana, battle for dharma, Hindu epic, Mahabharata story, Indian mythology, good vs evil.

comments.text:
The Mahabharata is an entertaining story that imparts some moral lessons, but that is where its purpose ends. The issue arises when religious individuals take the narrative literally. 

It's common for characters and events in epic poems to be exaggerated. Problems occur when the text is treated as religious scripture or a historical account. This concern applies to all religious texts from all religions.
